run_mask_spans_cli: run the mask_spans CLI to apply span masking on JSONL corpus files in a data directory
run_mask_spans_with_ratio: run mask_spans with a custom masking ratio and probability on batched shard files
run_mask_spans_multiprocess: run mask_spans across multiple files in parallel using a multiprocessing pool of up to 80 workers
review_mask_spans_find_files: review the find_files function that recursively discovers BS_shard JSONL files matching batch size
summarize_mask_spans_main: summarize the main function that orchestrates span masking with configurable masking ratio and probability parameters
